# nocthost_billing (Data Source)

Prepaid balance and total hourly spend across active servers (`GET /billing`). Requires an API token.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "nocthost_billing" "account" {}

output "balance_usd" {
  value = data.nocthost_billing.account.balance
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `balance` (Number) Prepaid balance, USD.
- `hourly_spend` (Number) Current spend per hour across active servers, USD.
